best_for: People with phone footage, screen recordings or ripped discs who want smaller files that play on any device, using presets instead of learning FFmpeg flags.
description:
HandBrake is a video converter, or transcoder, from the HandBrake Team. It takes video in nearly any format and turns it into files that use modern, widely supported codecs.

You can pick one title, a few chapters or just a time range from a source, and keep chapter markers in the result. Clean up old footage with deinterlace, denoise and deblock filters, or turn it grayscale. Encode to a constant quality or an average bitrate, and check a live preview before you start. Audio can be converted to AAC, MP3, FLAC, Opus and more, or passed through untouched, DTS-HD and TrueHD tracks included. HDR video can stay HDR, and SRT, SSA, VobSub and CEA-608 caption subtitles are supported.

points.title: Convert, not edit
points.text: HandBrake turns almost any video into MP4, MKV or WebM using x264, x265 and SVT-AV1. Presets match common devices, and a queue runs many jobs in a row. It crops, resizes and handles soft subtitles, but it cannot join clips into one video.

points.title: It will not break copy protection
points.text: HandBrake does not handle DRM from streaming services or many commercial discs. It can open copies made with a separate tool such as MakeMKV. It also cannot burn DVDs or Blu-rays.

points.title: Free, open source, built by volunteers
points.text: HandBrake is free under the GPL 2.0 with no account, ads or paid tier.

points.title: Wants a recent PC
points.text: The minimum listed is an Intel Core 9th gen, any AMD Ryzen or Apple M1, with 16 GB of RAM for HD and 32 GB for 4K. Hardware encoders from Intel, AMD, NVIDIA and Apple are supported and can speed things up.

points.title: Windows 10 is on borrowed time
points.text: Windows 11 is supported and Windows 10 is deprecated. The app needs the .NET Desktop Runtime 10. Windows 7 and 8.1 stopped at 1.3.3. On macOS, 14 and later are supported and 10.13 to 13 are deprecated.

points.title: Install details
points.text: Windows installers come for x64 and Arm64 and install for all users. The Mac app is universal. The Linux Flatpak is published by the HandBrake team and verified on Flathub, for x64 only.

points.title: Older versions on Windows
points.text: The Windows listing keeps 25 versions; macOS and Linux list only the current release, so downgrades there need another source.
